europeanStandards.title: WHAT IS MED EXPERT EU?
europeanStandards.point2: Objective evaluation of diagnosis and treatment without visas or language barriers.
europeanStandards.point4: Not a primary consultation, but a strategic analysis.

speed.title: WHO CONDUCTS THE AUDIT?
speed.point2: These are current certified specialist doctors from clinics in Germany and other European countries..
speed.point3: Prompt response - a ready-made solution in 24 hours.

channels.title: WHAT DO YOU RECEIVE?
channels.point1: Expert report (PDF): Official written document from a European specialist.
channels.point3: Roadmap: Step-by-step recommendations on which tests to take and which can be skipped.
channels.point4: Adaptation of expert recommendations by a local partner doctor.

privacy.title: HOW DOES THE AUDIT WORK?
privacy.point1: You send your data, questions, MRI, and test results via a secure chat.
privacy.point2: The expert reviews the data and may ask clarifying questions directly in chat.
privacy.point3: The doctor identifies possible diagnostic errors, hidden risks, or outdated methods (per Guidelines).
privacy.point4: You receive a PDF with a clear treatment strategy based on European evidence-based medicine.

alternative.title: WHAT TO DO WITH THE EUROPEAN REPORT?
alternative.point1: The European expert provides a strategy, but prescriptions and referrals are valid only from a local doctor. We bridge this gap.

feedback.title: Feedback and Service Improvement:
feedback.point1: Click the green button in the menu. A coordinator will match you with a licensed doctor in your city.
feedback.point2: Attend the consultation. The doctor is ready to work according to international standards.
feedback.point3: The doctor reviews the Med Expert report and adapts European protocols to your country (medications and tests).
feedback.point4: You receive a PDF with a clear treatment strategy based on evidence-based medicine.

joy.title: You leave the office with official documents:
joy.point3: Treatment plan under supervision of a local specialist.

important.title: Only MED EXPERT EU partner doctors work with our expertise form.
important.point1: External clinics may refuse to process European-style documents. Our local doctor:
important.point3: Provides referrals for procedures and tests.

profit.title: WHY IS THIS COST-EFFECTIVE?
profit.point1: European expertise at the price of a dinner.
profit.point2: Access to the 'Gold Standard' of medicine without travel costs.
profit.point3: In-person consultation in the EU: from €2,000.
profit.point4: Med Expert online audit—98% savings at the same expertise level.

problems.title: Why do people turn to us?

diagnosis.title: DO YOU DOUBT YOUR DIAGNOSIS?
diagnosis.point1: You received a diagnosis but are unsure of its accuracy?
diagnosis.point2: Our experts conduct an independent audit to confirm or refute your doctor’s conclusions.
diagnosis.point3: No attempt to sell unnecessary services.

treatment.title: TREATMENT NOT WORKING?
treatment.point1: Therapy has been ongoing for months without results?
treatment.point3: We select a modern treatment plan based on international standards.

surgery.title: WAS SURGERY RECOMMENDED?
surgery.point2: Often, conservative treatment methods are available in Europe.
surgery.point3: We check if your problem can be solved without surgery.

check.title: WANT TO VERIFY PRESCRIPTIONS?
check.point2: We check each prescription against Evidence-Based Medicine principles.
check.point3: Remove unnecessary ones, keep only what truly works.

secondOpinion.title: THE 'SECOND OPINION' ISSUE:
secondOpinion.point1: Patients visit 3–4 doctors and get different diagnoses.
secondOpinion.point2: You need an authoritative figure to make a final decision.
secondOpinion.point3: A European doctor acts as an independent highest authority (arbiter).

trust.title: CRISIS OF TRUST:
trust.point1: Stereotypes: 'they don’t treat properly,' 'over-treat,' or give wrong diagnoses.
trust.point3: SOLUTION: 'Medical tourism from your sofa.' Access European quality without flights or visas.

warning.title: Important!
warning.text1: The consultation is informational and provides an expert strategy ('Second Opinion'), but is not a medical service. European experts are not responsible for self-treatment based on the data provided.
warning.text2: To turn the European report into official prescriptions and referrals, use the service to find a partner doctor in your region (green button). Only an in-person doctor decides on treatment tactics and bears responsibility.
warning.emergency: In case of life-threatening situations, call 112.
